title: The token on the shared screen
concept: A secret that showed up on a shared screen is no longer a secret: revoke it and create a new one.
prompt: In a video call you shared your screen with the .env file open, and the API token was visible. What do you do first?

options.text: Close the file and hope nobody noticed
Revoke the token and create a new one
Ask everyone to delete the call recording

explanation: Anyone who saw the screen, or watches the recording, may have copied the token. Only revoking it makes it useless. Keep the new one in a secrets manager, off the screen.
